object_description: compact four-story prism organized around a central atrium
design_condition: The rotated, low and compact volume mediates between high-rise and low-rise neighbours while preserving flowing green spaces and forming a new address along the main pedestrian and bicycle route.

positive.statement: The new building and existing building naturally appear as a school ensemble.
The compact volume successfully mediates between the high-rise residential buildings and low-rise residential areas.
Well-proportioned green spaces integrate seamlessly into the open and flowing landscape.
The courtyard-like open space and hard court function as a connecting element and center for the pupils.
The compact sequence of shared facilities can be made more open or closed as required.
The internal organization of the school is very simple and practical.
The lighting of the sports hall via side light shafts is well solved.
The architectural appearance is very reduced and controlled.

negative.statement: The proposed entrance arcade seems strange in this context.
The path network to better connect the detached kindergarten is not expanded.
The shared facilities raise questions about suitability for everyday use and acoustics.
The ring-shaped corridor is hardly usable for teaching because it also serves as an escape route.
The central atrium has little spatial presence within the school.
A clear spatial structure of the individual clusters is not visible.
The workrooms in the basement without daylight are not optimally arranged.
A strong spatial center of the school is missing.
